briefing: Mythos Gates briefing: Remember the Silver-Root Court: Name at the Gate. Enter Silver-Root Court on Silver-Root Geas Labyrinth through The Silver-Root Gate while the Gate remains Sealed Gate with fae time bleed. Reference deity voice is Morrígan, but the player still chooses one deity from the faction roster. Objective: With one selected deity, cross the threshold in the Silver-Root Court, secure the first route marker, and mark the Gate law before the Hollow can read the name.

missionIntro.speaker: Morrígan Divine Voice
missionIntro.text: A geas is a road that remembers the foot that broke it. The Silver-Root Court will know whether one deity is enough.

enemyIntroduction.speaker: Lore Director
enemyIntroduction.text: Enemies are not filler here; they are the entry pressure of Silver-Root Geas Labyrinth made hostile.

midBattle.speaker: Gameplay Director
midBattle.text: Read the room law first: Exploit or avoid the route rule: fae time pools that age or reverse cooldowns

victory.speaker: Morrígan Divine Voice
victory.text: The root remembers obedience and opens one more ring.

defeat.speaker: Morrígan Divine Voice
defeat.text: Withdraw. The The Silver-Root Gate has learned too much from this attempt.

codex.speaker: Lore Director
codex.text: Avalora is the source Realm; mortal myth is only the later echo. This beat documents Silver-Root Court as part of Silver-Root Geas Labyrinth.

soloTitanPolicy: Dialogue supports one active battlefield deity; roster/Deity language is excluded from standard mission combat.
visualDirection: Frame Silver-Root Court as a entry node in Silver-Root Geas Labyrinth; silver branch crowns, moonlit green-gold, living bark armor, woven thorn mantles, mist veils, standing stone geometry, battle-crow omens, cauldron glow, druid knots as organic growth not decoration, geas scars, fae glass, root-lace anatomy.

mythosGatesDialogueRecreation.speakerRule: Use faction divine voice, Lore Director, or Gameplay Director; no playable Titan language.
mythosGatesDialogueRecreation.soloRule: Dialogue supports one active god or goddess in the field.

soloDeityPolicy: Dialogue supports one active battlefield deity; roster/Titan language is excluded from player-facing copy except legacy IDs.
